messages:
ana.support: FYI - new trial account 'orchid' is seeing intermittent 429s during onboarding bulk sync. Renewal check-in in 10 days, flagged by AM. :triangular_flag_on_post:
marco.cs: thanks. is this Hosted or Dedicated? any sample errors? what traffic pattern?
nana.support: Hosted. bulk sync runs as 5 concurrent workers, ~140 reqs/min bursts. sample error:
```
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"concurrency_limit_exceeded", "tenant_id":"acct-orchid", "route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```
also saw some 502s when retries piled up.
talia.eng: probable: parallel bulk uploads hit per-tenant concurrency (default 12). queued tasks caused worker timeouts. short mitigations: 1) temp concurrency override for tenant, 2) enable burst pooling + short queueing window, 3) ask customer to stagger uploads.
marco.cs: CS to own customer comms. Sam (AM) do you want to propose a trial extension or credit?
sam.am: yes, offer 1-week extension and executive sync if they sign before renewal. need exact cost delta for concurrency bump.
nana.support: paging ops-bot to request override: tenant=acct-orchid concurrency=48 burst=true.
ops-bot: Quota override requested for acct-orchid by ana.support. Change id: q-2026-07-02-11
ops-bot: Quota override applied: q-2026-07-02-11 (concurrency=48, burst=on)
ana.support: immediate effect - 429s dropped from ~22% to ~1%. p95 latency improved from ~2.0s to ~650ms. single 502 observed during switch.
marco.cs: CS comms plan (short): 1) immediate note with apology + what we changed + owner contact; 2) schedule 30m technical review within 24h with eng+support; 3) offer 1-week extension + feedback form; 4) deliver RCA and playbook for bulk-imports. I'll draft the message.
talia.eng: RCA bullets for customer doc: - Cause: bulk parallelism exceeded per-tenant concurrency, causing queueing and worker timeouts. - Temp fix: increased tenant concurrency + burst pool. - Next steps: add tenant-aware autoscaler, increase default concurrency for bulk paths, and SDK client-side guardrail for bulk imports.
marco.cs: owners: CS (marco) send customer note + invite; Support (ana) monitor override and keep until eng confirms fix; Eng (talia) provide RCA draft + ETA in 48h; AM (sam) handle renewal commercial. Ops: record change id for audit.
nana.support: meeting scheduled 2026-07-03 15:00 UTC, invites sent to customer + AM + eng.
ops-bot: Change q-2026-07-02-11 retention=on until 2026-07-09
marco.cs: adding feedback capture link to invite: https://forms.redwood/orchid-onsync-feedback
ana.support: customer replied: "Appreciate fast turnaround. We need a written playbook before prod ramp." tagged AM and eng.
sam.am: noted. will prep exec summary + proposed credit.
talia.eng: will post initial RCA in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
marco.cs: marking this thread P1 (renewal-watch) and pinging sales. please update when RCA + postmortem posted so CS can close. :white_check_mark:
